title: An intrinsic finite element framework for scalar- and vector-valued partial differential equations on general manifolds
summary: We present an intrinsic finite element framework for the numerical approximation of scalar- and vector-valued partial differential equations on general manifolds described by atlases of charts. Weak formulations and their discretisation are expressed exclusively in the flat parametric space of the manifold, where the exact geometry enters only through the metric tensor that is evaluated at quadrature points.
